name: 252-52365 in NGC 1977 (Webb)
blurb: 252-52365, a young star with a planet-forming disk irradiated by a nearby hot star in NGC 1977, seen by Webb.
label: 25252365-webb
story: One of seven proplyds in the Running Man Nebula, young stars whose disks are being slowly stripped by ultraviolet light from the B star 42 Orionis. They are the first proplyds found around a B star rather than an O star.

claims.text: 252-52365 is a JWST program 5269 target at RA 05 35 22.54, Dec -04 52 37.1, classed as a proplyd/protoplanetary disk
Program 5269 targets seven proplyds in NGC 1977 around the B star 42 Ori, exposed to strong external UV
252-52365 is KCFF#6, a disk around a 0.5 solar-mass star in NGC 1977 near 42 Ori
42 Ori is a B1V star; the disks lie near it in NGC 1977
The disks lose mass externally (being stripped) as well as accreting
Proplyds are young stars; the seven in NGC 1977 point toward 42 Ori, its main UV source, and are the first proplyds found around a B star
NGC 1977 is commonly known as the Running Man Nebula, a reflection nebula
NGC 1977 is part of the Running Man complex near the Orion Nebula
